description: This file is a JSON Schema definition and API description for the System API related to managing system-level features such as power, firmware, device information, and events in a set-top box or similar device. It includes definitions for data types, method specifications, and event notifications.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Collects device details such as MAC addresses, model, firmware version, etc. (Deprecated; use more specific methods).

methods.name: getDownloadedFirmwareInfo
methods.description: Provides information about the current and downloaded firmware versions and location.

methods.name: getFirmwareDownloadPercent
methods.description: Returns the current percentage of firmware download progress.

methods.name: getFirmwareUpdateInfo
methods.description: Checks for available firmware updates.

methods.name: getFirmwareUpdateState
methods.description: Returns the current state of a firmware update process.

methods.name: getLastFirmwareFailureReason
methods.description: Retrieves the reason for the last firmware update failure.

methods.name: getLastWakeupKeyCode
methods.description: Returns the last key code used to wake up the device.

methods.name: getMacAddresses
methods.description: Retrieves various MAC addresses associated with the device.

methods.name: getMfgSerialNumber
methods.description: Gets the manufacturing serial number.

methods.name: getNetworkStandbyMode
methods.description: Checks if WakeOnLAN/WLAN are supported.

methods.name: getPlatformConfiguration
methods.description: Gets supported features, device, and account info.

methods.name: getPowerState
methods.description: Returns the current power state of the device.

methods.name: getPowerStateBeforeReboot
methods.description: Gets the power state before last reboot.

methods.name: getRFCConfig
methods.description: Retrieves configuration information related to RDK feature control.

methods.name: getSerialNumber
methods.description: Returns the device serial number.

methods.name: getSystemVersions
methods.description: Provides details on system and receiver versions.

methods.name: getFriendlyName
methods.description: Gets the device's friendly name.

methods.name: getTerritory
methods.description: Retrieves configured system territory and region.

methods.name: getTimeZones
methods.description: Fetches available time zones from the system.

methods.name: getTimeZoneDST
methods.description: Gets the configured system time zone and daylight saving time info.

methods.name: getWakeupReason
methods.description: Returns why the device woke up from deep sleep.

methods.name: isOptOutTelemetry
methods.description: Checks if telemetry data collection is opted out.

methods.name: reboot
methods.description: Requests a device reboot.

methods.name: requestSystemUptime
methods.description: Provides the device uptime in seconds.

methods.name: setDeepSleepTimer
methods.description: Sets duration for deep sleep timeout.

methods.name: setFirmwareAutoReboot
methods.description: Enables or disables automatic reboot after firmware update.

methods.name: setMode
methods.description: Sets the device's operational mode for a specific duration.

methods.name: setNetworkStandbyMode
methods.description: Enables or disables network standby mode; deprecated in favor of setWakeupSrcConfiguration.

methods.name: setOptOutTelemetry
methods.description: Sets telemetry data collection opt-out status.

methods.name: setPowerState
methods.description: Sets the device power state.

methods.name: setFriendlyName
methods.description: Sets a user-friendly name for the device.

methods.name: setBootLoaderSplashScreen
methods.description: Configures the splash screen shown during device boot.

methods.name: getBuildType
methods.description: Returns the build type of the device firmware image.

methods.name: setTerritory
methods.description: Sets system territory and region; triggers event on change.

methods.name: setTimeZoneDST
methods.description: Configures system time zone and daylight saving time settings.

methods.name: setWakeupSrcConfiguration
methods.description: Configures wakeup sources; deprecated, use setWakeupSrcConfiguration API.

methods.name: updateFirmware
methods.description: Starts firmware update process.

methods.name: uploadLogsAsync
methods.description: Initiates background log upload.

methods.name: abortLogUpload
methods.description: Stops ongoing log upload.
